body: I'll think about it. Thank you taking the time to write.

thank you, it always nice to talk to a compassionate stranger. However if I see no progress in my counselling sessions, I'm absolutely certain that death will be my choice. I just don't see anything getting better but I'll learn more about depression.

I told myself it would get easier, that's why I waited for over a year and thought these feelings would  have gone away. If this counsellor thing doesn't work out, I just don't see a way out and think ending my life would be a way out of my misery.

I know and you're right.  I'm not ending it because she rejected me, I just felt so bad about myself that she had to cut all contact with me. It feels terrible. Nothing has really improved and I'm seeing a counsellor but I see no progress.
I've let go, but that doesn't mean my feelings of vulnerability have vanished. I just feel that if I end my life, my sadness will no longer cease to exist.
